# Mateus Mendonça Monteiro

> Backend Software Engineer. I build backend services in Go, Python, and Java, focusing on messaging and cloud infrastructure. Currently at Itaú Unibanco and doing MSc research at UNESP.

Python, Java, Go, Kubernetes | Microservices • Messaging • Cloud | MSc Researcher @UNESP | @Itaú Unibanco

- Website: https://mateusememe.github.io/whoami/
- Other languages: [Português](https://mateusememe.github.io/whoami/index.pt.md) · [Español](https://mateusememe.github.io/whoami/index.es.md)

## About Me

I'm a backend software engineer experienced in distributed systems and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP), working primarily with Java, Go, Python, and TypeScript. My daily work involves API design, messaging with Kafka and RabbitMQ, operating microservices on Kubernetes, and monitoring production with Datadog and Grafana. I also conduct MSc research in Computer Science at UNESP focused on artificial intelligence and machine learning.

## Experience

### Software Engineer — Itaú Unibanco

May 2026 – Present

Built tools for data migration between AWS accounts and Customer Data Platforms (CDP). Wrote microservices in Python and Go using event-driven architecture and Data Mesh. Built ETL pipelines with AWS Step Functions, Glue, and Lambda, monitored via CloudWatch, X-Ray, Datadog, and Grafana.

Stack: Python, Go, AWS, Step Functions, Glue, Lambda, KMS, CloudTrail, CloudWatch, X-Ray, Datadog, Grafana

### Backend Engineer — LuizaLabs

Jan 2025 – Apr 2026

Worked on search engines and high-throughput microservices. Stack: Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus), Node.js (Fastify), and TypeScript, backed by MongoDB, Redis, and Elasticsearch. Built GraphQL (Apollo Federation) and REST APIs, async messaging with RabbitMQ and Pub/Sub, deployed to Kubernetes and GCP via ArgoCD.

Stack: Java, Spring Boot, Quarkus, Node.js, Fastify, TypeScript, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, GraphQL, Apollo Federation, RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub, GCP, MagaluCloud, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, Datadog, Grafana

### Software Engineer — Vericode

Apr 2023 – Dec 2024

Maintained and deployed Java microservices with Spring and Quarkus on Kubernetes. Lowered startup time and memory use by 10%. Built REST APIs, authentication with Spring Security and JWT, MySQL and MongoDB storage, with CI/CD on Docker, Jenkins, SonarQube, and Bitbucket.

Stack: Java, Spring, Quarkus, Kubernetes, MySQL, MongoDB, Firestore, Spring Security, JWT, Docker, Jenkins, SonarQube, Bitbucket

### Software Engineer Intern — Vericode

Sep 2022 – Apr 2023

Built web applications using Next.js, React, and TypeScript. Improved rendering and SEO metrics by 20%. Integrated REST APIs and created interactive interfaces for no-code workflow builders.

Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, API Integration, SEO

### Software Engineer — ANBIMA

Dec 2022 – Jul 2024

Maintained and updated the Offer Registration System (SRO) for the CVM. Frontend in AngularJS and jQuery; backend in Java EE (VRaptor, EJB, Quartz, Liquibase). Migrated the codebase from Java 8 to Java 11 and managed the SQL Server database.

Stack: Java EE, VRaptor, Quartz, Jacoco, Liquibase, EJB, Angular.js, jQuery, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, SQL Server

### Software Development Intern — Prevision

Apr 2022 – Sep 2022

Built features for a construction planning SaaS platform used by 200+ companies and 1,000+ users across 2,600 job sites. Worked with React, Node.js, and Docker in the User Insights team.

Stack: JavaScript, React, Node.js, Docker

### Software Development Intern — Inova Prudente

Feb 2021 – Mar 2022

Created a web system for coworking space management, room booking, and event check-in. Stack: PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, and jQuery, containerized with Docker and tested using Robot Framework.

Stack: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, jQuery, MySQL, Docker, Robot Framework

## Projects

- [8-puzzle](https://github.com/mateusememe/8-puzzle) (17 stars): 8-puzzle solver using heuristic search with A* and Best-First Search algorithms based on Manhattan distance. Stack: Python, A* Algorithm, Heuristics, BFS.
- [git-github-in-action](https://github.com/mateusememe/git-github-in-action) (5 stars): Code examples and resources for the 'Git and GitHub in Action' workshop at 35th Infoeste, covering version control and workflows. Stack: Git, GitHub, Workflows, C++.
- [codecash](https://github.com/mateusememe/codecash) (4 stars): Transactional API built for the 'API Hero' workshop at DevFest 2025. Uses Spring Boot, GraphQL queries, PostgreSQL storage, and Redis caching. Stack: Java, Spring Boot, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Redis.
- [matarazzoProject](https://github.com/mateusememe/matarazzoProject) (4 stars): Web platform for cultural space management and booking, with interactive frontend and backend services in JavaScript and Node.js. Stack: JavaScript, Node.js, Express, Full Stack.
- [AlgorithmForest](https://github.com/mateusememe/AlgorithmForest) (2 stars): Implementation of tree data structures and algorithms in Java, including Binary Search Trees (BST) and AVL balancing. Stack: Java, Data Structures, BST, AVL.
- [zhang-suen-thinning](https://github.com/mateusememe/zhang-suen-thinning) (2 stars): Python implementation of the Zhang-Suen morphological thinning and skeletonization algorithm for binary images. Stack: Python, Computer Vision, Algorithms, Image Processing.
- [transaction.ledger](https://github.com/mateusememe/transaction.ledger): Financial order registration service on AWS serverless. Implements conditional writes for idempotency, outbox pattern with CDC, circuit breakers, and CloudWatch observability. Stack: Python, AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, Clean Arch.
- [lime.stability.imputation](https://github.com/mateusememe/lime.stability.imputation): MSc experimental research on LIME stability with data imputation techniques across RandomForest and GradientBoosting models. Stack: Python, Machine Learning, XAI, LIME, Research.

> Backend Software Engineer. Desenvolvo microsserviços em Go, Python e Java, com foco em mensageria e infraestrutura em nuvem. Trabalho no Itaú Unibanco e pesquiso no mestrado pela UNESP.

## Sobre Mim

Sou engenheiro de software backend com sólida experiência no desenvolvimento de sistemas distribuídos e infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS, GCP), atuando principalmente com Java, Go, Python e TypeScript. Minha rotina envolve o desenho de APIs, configuração de mensageria com Kafka e RabbitMQ, operação de microsserviços em Kubernetes e monitoramento de produção com Datadog e Grafana. Também realizo pesquisa de mestrado em Ciência da Computação na UNESP com foco em inteligência artificial e aprendizado de máquina.

## Experiência

### Engenheiro de Software — Itaú Unibanco

Mai 2026 – Presente

Desenvolvimento de ferramentas para migração de dados entre contas AWS e plataformas de dados de clientes (CDP). Criação de microsserviços em Python e Go usando arquitetura orientada a eventos e Data Mesh. Construção de pipelines ETL com AWS Step Functions, Glue e Lambda, com monitoramento via CloudWatch, X-Ray, Datadog e Grafana.

Stack: Python, Go, AWS, Step Functions, Glue, Lambda, KMS, CloudTrail, CloudWatch, X-Ray, Datadog, Grafana

### Engenheiro Backend — LuizaLabs

Atuação no motor de busca e em microsserviços com alto volume de acessos. Stack com Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus), Node.js (Fastify) e TypeScript, integrando com MongoDB, Redis e Elasticsearch. Desenvolvimento de APIs GraphQL (Apollo Federation) e REST, mensageria com RabbitMQ e Google Pub/Sub, e deploy em Kubernetes e GCP via ArgoCD.

Stack: Java, Spring Boot, Quarkus, Node.js, Fastify, TypeScript, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, GraphQL, Apollo Federation, RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub, GCP, MagaluCloud, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, Datadog, Grafana

# Mateus Mendonça Monteiro

> Backend Software Engineer. Desarrollo microservicios en Go, Python y Java, enfocados en mensajería e infraestructura en la nube. Trabajo en Itaú Unibanco e investigo en maestría en la UNESP.

- Sitio: https://mateusememe.github.io/whoami/

## Sobre Mí

Soy ingeniero de software backend con sólida experiencia en el desarrollo de sistemas distribuidos e infraestructura en la nube (AWS, GCP), trabajando principalmente con Java, Go, Python y TypeScript. Mi trabajo diario incluye diseño de APIs, mensajería con Kafka y RabbitMQ, operación de microservicios en Kubernetes y monitoreo de producción con Datadog y Grafana. También realizo investigación de maestría en Ciencias de la Computación en la UNESP enfocada en inteligencia artificial y aprendizaje automático.
